sources.verification: The statement reports 7 regions, 20 prefectures, 72 sub-prefectures and 175 communes functioning after the 2021 administrative-circumscription law and 2023 territorial-limits law.
sources.limits: It supplies no list of scoped 2018 communes or their current boundaries.
